instructions: Prepare the vegetables, aromatics, tempeh, and rice for tempeh fried rice.
Heat the cooking vessel and soften the aromatics until fragrant.
Add the seasoned tempeh and cook it until browned or heated through as appropriate.
Stir in the rice, vegetables, and sauce and cook until the mixture is tender and cohesive.
Taste the tempeh fried rice, adjust the seasoning, and portion it evenly while warm.
